verdict: Facebook spend collapsed to $3.85 in the latest period, signaling a stalled PCOS and postpartum lead campaign.
diagnosis: Total 28-day spend hit $2,330 but daily pace dropped from $13.63 average to just $3.85 recently, without lead or conversion data to justify cuts.

signals.headline: Spend fell 72% below period average
signals.detail: Latest daily spend of $3.85 versus the 28-day average of $13.63 suggests the campaign is throttling or nearly paused.

signals.headline: Only one active campaign running
signals.detail: The PCOS and postpartum persona campaign is the sole Facebook effort. No diversification means one creative fatigue event stops all leads.

signals.headline: Zero visibility across four channels
signals.detail: No Google Business Profile, organic social, CRM, or top-performer data. Impossible to judge whether $2,330 produced customers.

signals.headline: 28-day spend totals $2,330
signals.detail: Above the $900 monthly starter budget many studios use, so scale is reasonable if leads are actually flowing through.

recommendations.title: Confirm whether the campaign is intentionally paused
recommendations.detail: The drop from $13.63 to $3.85 daily needs explanation. If unintentional, restore budget. If intentional, document why and what replaces it.

recommendations.title: Connect lead and CRM data before next report
